Each time this damages at least one enemy champion, he generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Trample'' that lasts for the remaining duration, stacking up to 5 times.@@description2@@At 5 stacks, '''Alistar's''' next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] against a [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] within 6 seconds ends ''Trample's'' effects to deal 20 – 275 (based on level) '''bonus''' magic damage and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] the target for 1 second.@@description3@@{{{description3}}}@@description4@@{{{description4}}}@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@

@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@[[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] 350@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70@@cooldown@@12 / 11.5 / 11 / 10.5 / 10@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@Special@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * ''Trample'' deals [[File:Poison Trail.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent area damage]] [[:Damage|persistent area damage]] damage around '''Alistar''', while the bonus damage on the resulting attack is [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc damage]]. * The [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] and '''bonus''' damage are blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shields]] but the base attack damage is not. * The on-hit effect is consumed if the attack [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]], but not if it is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or missed while '''Alistar''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. In all cases, the attack's effects are negated as normal. * The bonus damage and stun can be applied by [[File:Guinsoo's Rageblade item.png|20xpx|border|link=Guinsoo's Rageblade|An icon for the item Guinsoo's Rageblade]] [[Guinsoo's Rageblade|Guinsoo's Rageblade's]] Phantom Hit if the triggering attack did not. ** If the triggering attack does however apply the bonus damage and stun already, then Phantom Hit cannot apply them a subsequent time by triggering on-hit effects, despite ''Trample's'' empowered attack being an on-hit effect.@@
